scope: Complete frozen-prefix independent diagnostic; proposed evaluation only, not acceptance activation or release qualification

equations.arithmetic: NumPy float64 with BLAS float64 dot products; no intermediate F32 rounding
equations.weights: Exact deployed Q4_K values independently decoded by gguf to F32, losslessly widened to F64; deployed F16/F32 values losslessly widened
equations.kvStorage: IEEE binary16 nearest ties to even immediately after K normalization/RoPE and V projection; widened to F64 on reads
equations.recurrence: Sequential gated delta recurrence from zero; causal convolution from zero; no captured state
equations.normalization: F64 mean square plus declared epsilon; Qwen offset weight 1+w, gated recurrent norm weight w
equations.rope: F64 positions and trigonometry; text positions equal across three MRoPE axes
equations.attention: Causal scaled dot product, F64 stable softmax, grouped KV heads, sigmoid output gate
equations.execution: One causal full 20-token sequence; report all 2 frozen prefixes; no generated-token feedback
equations.output: Full unmasked vocabulary logits; separately quantized deployed LM head; no retied embedding
